children: The price of the benchmark Brent Crude has surged to $100 per barrel for some contracts. This is the first time since July 24, 2026, nearly 2 months ago, that Brent has hit this mark.
This surge comes amid a resurgence in the escalation of hostilities between Iran and the US, and also between Iran, its proxies and other key players like Saudi Arabia in West Asia.
(This is a developing story, more detail will follow soon)

title: Brent crude hits $100 per barrel mark for first time since July 24
